title: Sprite editor opens the whole sheet, not just the preview frames
tier_reason: Changes HQ dashboard files only; git reverts it, and it's a tool surface rather than anything players see.
ask: The sprite editor should show every cell of a sheet, with the preview frames just highlighted as what animates.
first_action: In HQ's sprite editor, derive the cell grid from the actual sheet dimensions and cell size instead of the catalog's preview frame list, and render preview frames as a highlighted subset.
source_message:
> HQ's sprite editor only showed him a quarter of each sheet. 

Why aren't you also creating a story to fix this?
